page_note: Page is structurally bifurcated. The opening unit (segs 0-9) is heavily ecclesial: ritual practice (kiss, peace, right hand, worship, cheirotonia) within "the holy Church of Truth" — pure Manichaean ritual installation. The middle unit (segs 10-24) preserves a substratic eschatological psychopomp narrative: the Form of Light comes to the dying, draws them from darkness, the angel stretches forth his right hand, the soul worships her redeemer = the form of light, and is taken to the House of the Living Ones. This cosmos→cosmos mapping (soul → form of light → redeemer → house of Living Ones) is substrate-grade material despite the editorial framing. The closing unit (segs 25-33) is pure hortatory application: "this I say to you, my brothers and my members" listing the five ritual signs as a mystery received from the Father. Editorial fatigue score is moderate but masked by very high damage (76.5%). Editor's strategy here: bracket the substratic death-of-soul narrative with ecclesial ritual on one side and hortatory exhortation on the other, identifying the cosmological five signs with the church's ritual five signs.
